parts:
Hi, I know that was discussed before.

I downloaded last version fo camtrapR from Github

ried the function filterRecordTable but it returns the error:

Error in filterRecordTable(recordTable = Asilvestrado, minDeltaTime = 30,  :
  recordDateTimeCol 'Fechahora' could not be converted to a date-time object.

The recordTable comes from an Excel file read in R. This file has all the fields that are delivered with the recordTable() function. 

Once read in R the Excel file, using the readxl , DateTimeOriginal appears as POSIXct format 
I tried convert it to character but the error is the same
i tried to read the file as CSV and the same. If saved as CSV the DateTimeOriginal filed is read as character with the format "dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm:ss".

Tried different formats of date and time in base R and the same 

I attach an example subset


Any thoughts? 

Thanks

messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Error in filterRecordTable
parts:
Hi, 
from what I see the table is ok. As you noted the date time column has a nonstandard Format, so you'll need to set recordDateTimeFormat accordingly.
I don't see a column "Fechahora" which you seem to use as recordDateTimeCol. The standard DateTimeOriginal should work just fine.

If that doesn't work please share the full code you used and str() if your record table.

Best,
Jürgen
